description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to shape the delivery of high-quality patient care and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a compassionate leader who is committed to clinical excellence and operational efficiency.The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and developing comprehensive care plans. You will play a crucial role in staff management, training, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This is an urgent opening, and we are actively seeking to fill this position with a qualified professional who can make an immediate impact.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment. Join a team dedicated to providing exceptional care and making a difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with at least 1-2 years in a leadership or supervisory role.
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
